title: Fix drive.v3.permissions.create Discovery examples to prevent default email notifications and Shared Drive failures
description: In docs/site/commands/discovery.md (lines 30-33) and skills/google-drive-cli/references/discovery.md (lines 41-45), the 'drivectl call drive.v3.permissions.create' examples omit '"sendNotificationEmail": false' and '"supportsAllDrives": true'. Because Google Drive API v3 defaults sendNotificationEmail=true on user and group grants when omitted, running those examples (or an agent copying them from references/discovery.md) sends unexpected email notifications, fails on Shared Drives, and lacks a pre-grant no-downgrade check. Update both examples to include '"sendNotificationEmail": false, "supportsAllDrives": true' and add a warning note in docs/site/commands/discovery.md, docs/site/architecture.md, and skills/google-drive-cli/references/discovery.md recommending share-with (https://github.com/ghchinoy/share-with) for silent-only permission grants, ?resourcekey=... URL parsing, and no-downgrade collaborator protection.
close_reason: Updated drive.v3.permissions.create Discovery examples with sendNotificationEmail=false and supportsAllDrives=true and added share-with ACL safety callouts
